name: Galbani
description: A tasty website for Italy's No.1 cheese brand, featuring a recipe finder with exclusive recipes from chefs and food bloggers.
bodyHtml:
About Galbani

Dating back to 1882, when father and son Davide & Egidio Galbani first made cheese in the Alpine valley village of Ballabio, Galbani is Italy's favourite cheese brand — selling more than 300 products in 50 countries.

Recipe Finder & Content

For the site, Galbani teamed up with several chefs and food bloggers to create a range of exclusive recipes using Galbani products — e.g. Lamb Cutlet, Sweet Potato & Mozzarella Tray Bake; Roasted Pepper, Sausage and Mozzarella Bake; Chocolate Ice Cream with Mascarpone.

Recipes can be searched and filtered by style, course and cooking time. Recipes are dynamically linked to their products and author, allowing users to browse content types with ease and share to social media.

Technology

Built using WordPress with a mobile-friendly responsive design. WordPress Custom Fields store the various product/recipe content types; a custom search implementation powers the recipe finder.

Visual Design

Galbani's blue brand colour is prominent throughout; lots of food photography bring the products and recipes to life.

name: e.fundamentals
description: A responsive WordPress website and design system for an international marketing and analytics platform provider, featuring 20+ components.
bodyHtml:
Project Overview

e.fundamentals required a website to showcase their services and methodology, handling a large amount of content that needed to be easy to update, consistent in aesthetic, and offer a wide variety of re-usable content blocks to convey complex content appealingly.

The result was a design system containing over 20 unique components, plus font, colour, sizing and branding elements.

Performance & Technology

The client had previously used Divi (a WordPress page builder known for slow, bloated output). After investigating alternatives, Oxygen was recommended — it delivered better performance and produced creditable scores despite some third-party tools and limited server control.

Performance Scores: GTmetrix Grade B, 86/83

Features

The site features:

  • Large resource section for blog posts, media and resources
  • Internationalisation for different content across international markets
  • Extensive custom forms and data capture elements to increase user engagement

Testimonial

"The harmony between design and technical execution was great, unlike dealing with other providers in the past there was no friction or issues that you can normally see between design and tech implementations. On top of that the speed of activity was strong, responsive and no request we had was ever pushed back on. Absolutely delighted with the finished product."

— Scott Ferguson, e.fundamentals, London

name: Bandstands
description: A cross-platform app allowing participants to navigate and discover 8 historical bandstands across Edinburgh and Musselburgh. Built with React and Expo.
bodyHtml:
Project Overview

The Arty Walk Porty project conceived an immersive sound-based performance and exhibition to celebrate and commemorate 8 historical bandstands across Edinburgh & Musselburgh. Events included musical performances across various locations, culminating in a procession along Portobello promenade.

"Marking the spaces of where bandstands once stood, and some still do, this project brings together a sense of discovery through sound..."

— Rosy Naylor, Platform Designs, Edinburgh

The mobile app encourages users to visit all 8 bandstand sites. Each location features an accompanying melodic loop composed by sound artist Ross Whyte and performed by the Portobello Community Choir.

How It Works

The user is guided towards each location; when close, the sound file begins playing, increasing in volume as they approach. Once near enough the location is 'unlocked' — or the user can scan a QR code from physical markers at each site.

As each location is collected, the user is rewarded with imagery and historical information; the loop becomes playable. When 3+ are visited, collected loops can be combined into a unique composition. Together all loops form a complete song: 'The Great Exhibition'.

Technology

Built with React and the Expo framework (React Native). Device APIs used include:

  • Camera (QR code scanning)
  • Geolocation and Device Motion (maps and waypoints)
  • Keep Awake (keeping app and sound active)

Visual Design

Minimal yet playful; green and purple colour scheme; old photographs of historic bandstands.

name: Navigator Partnership
description: A responsive WordPress website for a Glasgow-based marketing services partner working across web, digital and creative. Modern with a duotone-like colour scheme; interface elements that break out of a structured grid layout.

name: SooUK
description: A contemporary online design store based near Edinburgh. The site showcases a mutual love of beautiful product design, interiors and architecture. Modern and contemporary with a minimal black & white colour scheme, allowing bold product and interior photos to stand out.

name: The Pet Business
description: A retailer, wholesaler and distributor of high quality pet products with a focus on quality, ethical, innovative products. Most products sourced from American and Canadian companies. Fun and warm visual design; soft lily pink and purple colour scheme.

name: Variprint
description: A bold, modern and mobile-responsive design for a print and design company based in Paisley, near Glasgow. VariPrint differentiates themselves by focussing on quality, being eco-conscious and not being afraid to pull an all-nighter! Dark overall with bright splashes of brand red; fairly complex grid-based layout.

name: Forth Valley Art Beat
description: A cross-platform mobile app and responsive WordPress website for the 'Open Studios Weekend' and 'Art Cycle' events. One of the largest cultural events in the Forth Valley area, the app helps visitors find venues, discover artists and get directions. Website: GTmetrix Grade A, 99/90.
